messages:
julie: Heads-up: FinReg just signed for a private on‑prem deployment; they need HSM-backed keys, dedicated GPU pools, and network isolation. Asking for a Q3 pilot — can we map dependencies and gating? cc @alex @sam @li

alex: 👍 Runtime impact: model kernels look fine, but we need persistent KV cache and a quantization profile pinned. Also want a warmup hook to avoid first-request latency spikes.

sam: Infra: Dedicated pools OK but we need 2 racks in their DC region, NIC-level tagging for isolation, and a service-account whitelist. Procurement + capacity ~4 weeks if we order now.

li: Security: HSM integration + audit log ingestion required. Need threat-model + compliance signoff. Also require KMS rotation policy and offline key import SOP.

maria: Product: what's the minimum launch criteria? Customer asks for 99ms p50 SLA for chat_api and data-at-rest encryption. They also want a canary + rollback plan.

alex: Can meet latency if we allow reduced batch sizes and prewarm. Quick checklist: persistent KV, prewarm hook, quant_profile v2. Example config snippet:```
cache:
  kv_persist: true
  warmup_keys: /etc/kv/warmup.txt
runtime:
  quant_profile: q4_2_v2
```

sam: Noted. Also networking needs: IP allowlist + VLAN tagging + BGP for colocation. Ops will need a maintenance playbook and runbook for DR.

li: I'll need a design doc with threat model and acceptance tests. Owner? @alex can you draft the integration section, @sam take infra/network, I'll add security controls and acceptance criteria.

alex: I'll draft runtime/integration section by EOD Wed. Also need QA for cache warmup — we should simulate traffic and verify p50 under load.

julie: OK owners: Alex (runtime), Sam (infra), Li (security), Maria (customer stakeholder). Timeline target: pilot the week of 3078200000 (~mid-Q3). Can everyone call out any blockers?

maria: Customer expects canary rollout: 1% traffic for first 48h, then 10% for 72h, then ramp to 100% assuming no regressions. They also want rollback window documented.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: INF-4921 — "FinReg private on‑prem pilot: infra + runtime + security integration" (assignee: unassigned) :ticket:

sam: Blocker: procurement for racks might slip and push timeline. Mitigation proposal: use partner colo for pilot to shorten lead time. @julie ok to propose to customer as fallback?

julie: Yes propose partner colo fallback. Include clear pricing delta and expected timeline improvement. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Runbook template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/finreg-onprem-template — ready for PR.

li: Security gating: must pass automated infra/config scans and audit-log ingestion test before we start canary. I'll add pass/fail criteria to the ticket.

alex: One more runtime note: KV persistence requires a small schema migration. I'll attach a patch to INF-4921 and request a 2‑hour maintenance window for migration.

maria: Great. Next cross-team sync: 14:00 Wed. I'll put on calendar and invite stakeholders. Action items: owners update INF-4921 with docs/owners/timeline by tomorrow COB.

julie: Thanks all — owners to update ticket by COB tomorrow. If anything blocks earlier, ping @julie and we'll triage.
